scope: Proposition 3.7 (Spread-source energy) of the manuscript “Bloch's Law for Finite-Range Heisenberg Ferromagnets in Three Dimensions” (preprints/Blochs-Law-for-Finite-Range-Heisenberg-Ferromagnets-in-Three-Dimensions-October-5-2026/bloch-law-heisenberg.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 271 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4884bc0984dfd0f6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 19. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose R ≥ R0, 1 ≤ τ ≤ R, and the slice t is regular for z at radius R. Let µ ≥ 0 be supported on available slots above BR(z), with ∥µ∥1 ≤ 1, ∥µ∥2 ≤ C1τ−3/4 . For every finitely supported real function Y on Ht, |⟨µ, Y ⟩|2 ≤ Cτ−1/2 Dt(Y ). (3.18) The constant may depend on C1 and the fixed geometry, but is independent of τ, R, the slice, and the volume.
